info.name: Athkar API
info.description:
Import this collection and Athkar.local.postman_environment.json, then select that environment. Set base_url (no trailing slash), mobile credentials and admin credentials locally. Secrets are intentionally empty in exports. Mobile and admin are separate top-level folders. Admin: CSRF Cookie -> Login -> selected request; cookie jar must stay enabled. Mobile: Register/Login captures mobile_token, Create Guest Identity captures guest_token. Create operations capture separate owned IDs. Sample numeric defaults are Quran references only; set public content IDs to existing published records. Set optional media paths from successful uploads. All mutation requests are explicit: do not run the whole collection against production. No requests were executed while creating this collection. Scripts assert success status and capture response values without logging secrets. Postman cookie scripting reference: https://learning.postman.com/latest-v-12/docs/tests-and-scripts/write-scripts/postman-sandbox-reference/pm-cookies

MOBILE TESTING: Guest — No Account Required for anonymous use; Logged In — Mobile Bearer Token for accounts; Public APIs for both. Optional Transfer requires a logged-in account. Runnable Scenarios create unique synthetic accounts and temporary Wird: run one scenario folder against development only. Scenario secrets use separate scenario_* environment variables and are cleared afterward.
ADMIN USERS: Users folder supports CRUD and web-role replacement. Run the independent admin user scenario with an administrator holding manage-users, manage-roles, view-users and manage-content. Run php artisan db:seed --class=ContentPermissionSeeder to define new permissions; explicit local AdminSeeder invocation upgrades the existing complete demo administrator.

item.name: Mobile App
item.description: Choose Guest, Public APIs or Logged In based on authentication needs. guest-claim is optional account migration, not guest authentication. Three independent runnable development scenarios verify lifecycle and transfer behavior. Mobile requests disable cookies.

item.name: Runnable Scenarios — Development Only
item.description: Run ONE scenario folder at a time. Unique test accounts remain in the target database. Use the manual folders for existing accounts or provider-backed features.
